verdict.rationale: Figma exposes a REST API, webhooks, and plan access tokens explicitly described as suited for CI/CD and unattended automation (figma-docs-57), backed by a documented OpenAPI spec and machine-readable API (figma-docs-46, figma-probe-rt-3). Its Code Connect CLI was also verified to run keylessly via npx with no interactive login (figma-probe-rt-1), showing genuine CI-friendly tooling. However, Figma's core design/editing product is not something run headlessly — only adjacent API/CLI/webhook layers support automation, not the product itself. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of a headless/CI mode for the core app, independent case studies of CI pipelines using Figma's API, and confirmation the MCP server can run unattended in CI (it requires OAuth per figma-probe-rt-2).
